alt: 一對伴侶在車站入口依依道別，各自帶著行李走向不同出口。
scene_prompt: Meaning: people who were close, especially a couple, are forced to part and go separate ways. Modern gentle scene: at a train station entrance, an adult couple stand on opposite sides of a clear departure line, each carrying a small suitcase, sharing a tender wistful farewell; one turns toward a departing train platform while the other turns toward the street exit, with their paths visibly diverging. Show kindness and unavoidable separation, not a joyful vacation or argument. Keep only two adults, anatomically natural with exactly two arms and legs each, natural suitcase handles and wheels, grounded feet, credible station perspective.
